    In a high-stakes April 12, 2026, matchup, the Boston Celtics reserves defeated the Orlando Magic 113-108. Boston was led by career-high performances from Baylor Scheierman (30 points, 6-14 3PT) and Ron Harper Jr. (27 points). Paolo Banchero recorded a 23-point, 11-assist, 10-rebound triple-double for Orlando. 
    Key Player Stats: Magic 108 vs. Celtics 113 (April 12, 2026) 
    • Boston Celtics (Top Performers):
      • Baylor Scheierman: 30 pts, 6-14 3PT
      • Ron Harper Jr.:
        27 pts, 5-12 3PT
      • Luka Garza: 27 pts, 12 reb
    • Orlando Magic (Top Performers):
      • Paolo Banchero: 23 pts, 11 ast, 10 reb
      • Jalen Suggs: 23 pts, 8-17 FG
      • Franz Wagner: 20 pts, 7-18 FG 
    Game Summary 
    • Result: Celtics defeated the Magic 113-108.
    • Key Run: Boston's bench led a 13-0 surge in the second half to secure the win.
    • Significance: The win sent the Magic into a play-in game against the 76ers.
